Message:
clk: qcom: gcc-ipq6018: Use floor ops for sdcc clocks

SDCC clocks must be rounded down to avoid overclocking the controller.

Fixes: d9db07f088af ("clk: qcom: Add ipq6018 Global Clock Controller support")
